course_title: HTML Fundamentals: Building Web Page Structure

lessons.title: Welcome to HTML Fundamentals
lessons.lesson_focus: Orient the learner to what this course builds toward.

lessons.title: What is HTML?
lessons.lesson_focus: Establish HTML as a markup language rather than a programming language.
lessons.key_insight: HTML is not a programming language — it's a markup language that describes and structures content.

lessons.title: The HTML Document Structure
lessons.lesson_focus: Introduce the boilerplate every HTML document shares.

lessons.title: HTML Elements: Opening and Closing Tags
lessons.lesson_focus: Explain how opening and closing tags delimit an element's content.
lessons.key_insight: Every piece of content lives between an opening and closing tag (or inside a self-closing one) — and getting the nesting right is what gives a page structure.

lessons.title: HTML Attributes: Adding Settings to Elements
lessons.lesson_focus: Practice adding attributes that configure an element's behavior.
lessons.key_insight: Attributes are the 'settings' on an HTML element — without them, an image has no source and a link has no destination.

lessons.title: Headings and Paragraphs: Writing Text Content
lessons.lesson_focus: Structure text content with headings and paragraphs.

lessons.title: Embedding Images
lessons.lesson_focus: Embed images and describe them for accessibility.

lessons.title: Nesting and Indentation: Organizing Your Code
lessons.lesson_focus: Check that nested elements are indented consistently.

lessons.title: Building a Complete HTML Page
lessons.lesson_focus: Combine every earlier concept into one complete page.

lessons.title: Course Wrap-Up and Next Steps
lessons.lesson_focus: Consolidate what the course covered and point at what comes next.
